notices.title: Multi-chain fund with limited on-chain telemetry
notices.message: BENJI is the multi-chain share token of Franklin Templeton's FOBXX money market fund. The fund is also deployed on Stellar (primary), Polygon, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Aptos, Base, Solana, BNB Chain, and Canton, but Pharos currently tracks only the Ethereum supply contract pending per-chain verification. Live reserves use a curated weekly snapshot of the official fund factsheet until an on-chain NAV oracle becomes available.
